name: Playwright MCP
description: Microsoft browser-automation MCP server (@playwright/mcp). Default packaging is stdio; '--port' enables an HTTP endpoint at /mcp, which v1 cannot record on the same item. The README states it is not a security boundary.

provenance.notes: npm dist-tag latest 0.0.83 published 2026-09-28; license Apache-2.0; mcpName io.github.microsoft/playwright-mcp. Supports version.

Registry entry io.github.microsoft/playwright-mcp lists version 0.0.82 (npm @playwright/mcp, transport stdio), status active, published 2026-09-18; registry lags npm by one patch. Supports transport and publisher identity. trust_level is a t4c research suggestion, not a security approval: trusted_external = maintained by the vendor whose API it fronts or by a named organisation, with publisher identity checked against the official MCP Registry namespace or the vendor's own docs; it does not make returned content trusted (see note, #35).

README: stdio configs; '--port' enables HTTP transport (url http://localhost:8931/mcp); --host defaults to localhost; --allowed-origins 'does not serve as a security boundary'; 'Playwright MCP is not a security boundary'. No server-side authentication option documented, recorded as auth none.
LICENSE is Apache License 2.0. Supports license.
